page_title: EIN 1-1 WOL | Eintracht Frankfurt v Wolfsburg 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card.
90+6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

90+4' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
90+4' The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+2' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.

88' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
88' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
87' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Eintracht Frankfurt.
86' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
85' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to make a change. Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) replaces Jonas Wind.
85' Substitution. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) replaces Mohamed Amoura.

85' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.

82' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
81' 1 - 1 Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
79' The attendance is 56000.
79' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
79' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
78' The resulting corner from Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes to nothing.

78' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
75' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Tiago Tomas and he is replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Wolfsburg).
75' Today's match ends for Mattias Svanberg who will be replaced by Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg).

74' Kamil Grabara pulls off a decent save! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.

72' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
72' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Benjamin Brand and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) coming on for Nathaniel Brown.
68' Ellyes Skhiri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
66' Ralph Hasenhuttl is forced to make a change. Kamil Grabara is unable to continue due to injury, Marius Muller (Wolfsburg) comes on.
64' Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
63' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.

63' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
60' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Kamil Grabara is alert and denies him.
60' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Ansgar Knauff.
57' Here is a change. Oscar Hojlund is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
56' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

55' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net but Kamil Grabara keeps it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner.
55' It seemed like Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

54' Eintracht Frankfurt slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
53' Benjamin Brand sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
52' Wait! Referee Benjamin Brand has indicated he is going to review the Wolfsburg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
50' 0 - 1 Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts the ball past his own goalkeeper.
50' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
49' Wolfsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
47' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Benjamin Brand has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45+2' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
45+2' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Caution goes to Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg).
45+1' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Wonderful movement by Wolfsburg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
40' Half-chance! Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Kamil Grabara reacts well to snuff out the attack.
39' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
39' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a throw-in.

37' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Eintracht Frankfurt are taking a throw-in.
35' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

33' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Kevin Trapp easily makes the save.
31' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

30' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) controls the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up low in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Kevin Trapp.
30' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Wolfsburg will take a free kick near the side line.
29' Wolfsburg keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
26' The foul by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) was seen by Benjamin Brand who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

25' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) blows a huge chance! The ball rebounded out to the edge of the box and he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
24' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

24' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
22' The ball is cleared after Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
20' A rebound falls for Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender.

17' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
15' Robin Koch is substituted due to injury. Dino Toppmoller gives a chance to Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt).
15' Eintracht Frankfurt showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
12' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' A raking crossfield pass from Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.

7' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Kamil Grabara has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
5' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

4' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

3' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies just over the crossbar, almost brushing it. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
2' Kevin Trapp displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolfsburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Wolfsburg will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benjamin Brand.
